decay.note: Authored from botanical descriptions of cascara: elliptic blades 5 to 15 cm with prominent, parallel side veins, on petioles of 1 to 2 cm, yellow in autumn and drying brown. Colours and curl chosen by eye; numbers plausible, not measured.

look.note: Authored: the drawn look's mean hue at the brightness chosen by eye for this species' litter, the relief the drawing has, and a tile its pieces repeat on unseen. PlantGen's litter tests check the hue and relief against the drawing.
